# Pavel on AsyncAPI

> AsyncAPI tools and documentation by Pavel Bodiachevskii, AsyncAPI Technical Steering Committee member and maintainer: a JetBrains IDE plugin (with Spring Messaging documentation generation), the announced Kurkik and AsyncAPI Language Server, the open-source JAsyncAPI library, and free reference docs for AsyncAPI bindings and JSON Schemas.

## Tools
- [AsyncAPI plugin for JetBrains IDEs](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/jetbrains-plugin/): write, validate and preview AsyncAPI; generate AsyncAPI from Spring Messaging code (Kafka, JMS, SNS, SQS, Pulsar, STOMP, SSE). Free core, paid extras.
- [Kurkik](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/kurkik/): announced. Document live Kafka, Pulsar, SNS and SQS systems as AsyncAPI 3.0 and detect drift.
- [JAsyncAPI](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/jasyncapi/): free Apache-2.0 JVM library for AsyncAPI documents.
- [AsyncAPI Language Server](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/language-server.html): in development, for VS Code, Zed and Sublime Text.

## Reference
- [AsyncAPI bindings](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/bindings/): 20 brokers with examples.
- [AsyncAPI JSON Schemas](https://asyncapi.pavelon.dev/schemas/): documents, bindings, security and multi-format schemas.
- [JSON Schema registry](https://schemas.asyncapi.pavelon.dev)
